dispatch_instructions: Delegate using the bundled dispatch_agent.py in detached form: `start` each specialist, then collect them with one blocking `wait` (re-issue it on exit 75), as described under "Detached dispatch" below. Run `start` and `wait` outside the sandbox (escalated), like any dispatch_agent.py call. Never poll with sleep, empty write_stdin, or transcript reads. Codex writer runs use codex exec --worktree --sandbox workspace-write. Read-only roles (security/review/research/bulk-reader) route to Claude Code and fail closed if unavailable. Packaged agent TOML descriptors are templates; automatic plugin-agent discovery and tool boundaries are not yet verified.
